mechanism: Two ablative helmet pockets accept flag-restricted armor attachments; attachments are CANT_WEAR and cover mouth_chin/eyes through the parent helmet.
bn_limitations: Existing ARMOR helmet_bike does not have DDA ablative pockets or inherited protection from pocket contents.
Defining the item_group with container-item helmet_bike would not reproduce wearable protection or attachment/removal.
A decorative container or ordinary helmet replacement is not dependency closure.
Full DDA pocket port is outside this local farm adapter; investigate a reusable BN attachment mechanism before enabling group.
resolution: Use stock helmet_bike for helmet_bike_modified and helmet_riding shop loot under the user policy of 2026-10-18. Source attachments remain archived only; they are not required dependencies of the farm port.
note: native_enabled refers to DDA modular attachments, not the stock helmet or farm payload.
